build_incremental_decoder: build a python module that subclasses FairseqIncrementalDecoder to implement custom incremental decoding logic
create_forward_pass: create a forward pass method in a FairseqIncrementalDecoder subclass that processes prev_output_tokens with encoder output
extract_decoder_features: extract features from prev_output tokens using the extract_features method of a FairseqIncrementalDecoder subclass
reorder_incremental_state: reorder the incremental state dictionary during beam search using reorder_incremental_state_scripting on the decoder
set_beam_size: set the beam size on a FairseqIncrementalDecoder and all its child modules using set_beam_size
